state.objective: Discover and behaviorally verify security vulnerabilities across permitted targets (http://dvwa and http://juiceshop:3000) within strict HTTP, LLM, and duration budgets.

findings.title: Unauthenticated User-Feedback PII Exposure
findings.response_evidence: HTTP 200 without authentication. Returns feedback records disclosing author email addresses embedded in comments, e.g. "(***in@juice-sh.op)", "(***@juice-sh.op)", "(***der@juice-sh.op)", "(***ereum@juice-sh.op)" — associated with UserId 1,2,3,21. PII (email addresses) disclosed to anonymous users.

findings.title: Exposed Encryption-Keys Directory
findings.response_evidence: Directory browsable HTTP 200, listing exposes jwt.pub (248 bytes) and premium.key (50 bytes). Direct retrieval of /encryptionkeys/premium.key returned HTTP 200 with key content: "1337133713371337.EA99A61D92D2955B1E9285B55BF2AD42".

findings.title: Confidential Document via Open Directory Listing
findings.response_evidence: /ftp/ directory listing (HTTP 200) reveals acquisitions.md (909 bytes). Direct retrieval returns confidential memo: "# Planned Acquisitions ... This document is confidential! Do not distribute! Our company plans to acquire several competitors within the next year. This will have a significant stock market impact..."

findings.title: Product-Search SQL Injection
findings.response_evidence: Single quote q=qwert' triggers HTTP 500: "Error: SQLITE_ERROR: near \"'%'\": syntax error". A 9-column UNION injection q=x')) UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9-- returns HTTP 200 with injected row mapping columns: {\"id\":1,\"name\":2,\"description\":3,\"price\":4,...\"deletedAt\":9}, proving column count and injection control.

findings.title: Login Authentication-Bypass SQL Injection
findings.response_evidence: HTTP 200 returns valid authentication token for first user: {\"authentication\":{\"token\":\"[REDACTED_JWT]\",\"bid\":1,\"umail\":\"admin@juice-sh.op\"}}. Authentication bypassed with no valid password, logging in as admin@juice-sh.op.

findings.title: Poison Null-Byte Path Traversal under /ftp/
findings.response_evidence: Raw /ftp/package.json.bak returns HTTP 403 "Only .md and .pdf files are allowed!". Appending URL-encoded null byte + allowed extension /ftp/package.json.bak%2500.md bypasses the filter, returning HTTP 200 with the restricted backup file content: {\"name\":\"juice-shop\",\"version\":\"6.2.0-SNAPSHOT\",...dependencies...}.

findings.title: Cross-User Basket Access / BOLA
request_sequence: GET /rest/basket/6 (session=juiceshop_acct1, own_basket_id=6) -> owns Apple Juice qty 3
GET /rest/basket/6 (session=juiceshop_acct2, own_basket_id=7) -> HTTP 200 returns acct1's basket
findings.response_evidence: Account 1's own basket is id 6 (UserId 22) containing distinct item "Apple Juice (1000ml)" quantity 3. Authenticated as acct2 (own_basket_id=7), GET /rest/basket/6 returned HTTP 200 disclosing Account 1's basket contents: Apple Juice (1000ml), BasketId 6, quantity 3. No ownership check enforced.

findings.title: SQL Injection (low)
findings.response_evidence: [security=low] TRUE condition (1' OR '1'='1) returns multiple seeded user surnames: admin, Brown (Gordon), Me (Hack), Picasso (Pablo), Smith (Bob). FALSE condition (1' AND '1'='2) returns zero records (empty result). Boolean-based SQLi confirmed.

findings.title: OS Command Injection (low)
findings.response_evidence: [security=low] Response output after ping statistics contains web-process identity "www-data", proving injected `whoami` executed via ';' separator.

findings.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (low)
findings.response_evidence: [security=low] Canary script (exactly 50 chars, fits mtxMessage maxlength=50) stored in guestbook. On rendering page the injected <script id="test_token"> executed.
findings.browser_js_evidence: browser_eval_js("window.xss_flag") returned 1, proving stored script executed in authenticated browser DOM context.

findings.title: SQL Injection (medium)
findings.response_evidence: [security=medium] id is POST field with quotes escaped; numeric boolean used. TRUE (1 OR 1=1) returns all 5 seeded surnames: admin, Brown, Me, Picasso, Smith. FALSE (1 AND 1=2) returns zero records. Page confirms "Security Level: medium".

findings.title: OS Command Injection (medium)
findings.response_evidence: [security=medium] ';' and '&&' are blacklisted; pipe used. Payload 127.0.0.1| whoami returned output "www-data" (web-process identity). Page confirms "Security Level: medium".

findings.title: OS Command Injection (high)
findings.response_evidence: [security=high] '; ', '| ' (pipe+space) and '&&' blacklisted; used pipe with no trailing space. Payload 127.0.0.1|whoami returned "www-data". Page confirms "Security level set to high / Security Level: high".

findings.title: SQL Injection (high)
findings.response_evidence: [security=high] id submitted out-of-band via session-input.php; query appends LIMIT 1 so trailing comment (#) required. TRUE payload 1' OR '1'='1' # returned all 5 seeded surnames: admin, Brown, Me, Picasso, Smith (comment nullified LIMIT 1). FALSE payload 1' AND '1'='2' # returned zero records. Page confirms "Security Level: high".
